title: Parent developmental check-in
disclaimer: This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.

questions.text_en: Does your child look at your face or eyes when you talk or play together?
Does your child smile back when you smile at them?
Does your child prefer to play alone, even when other children are around?
Does your child get very upset or very excited for no clear reason?
Does your child seem unaware of danger, for example running towards traffic?
Does your child point or use gestures to show you what they want?
Does your child repeat words or phrases they heard instead of answering you?
Does your child take turns with you in simple back-and-forth talk, sounds or games?
Does your child flap their hands, rock, spin or repeat the same body movements?
Does your child get very upset when a routine or something around them changes?
Does your child have strong tantrums or hit other people?
Does your child cover their ears or get upset with everyday sounds, lights or touch?
Does your child smell, lick or touch objects or people in an unusual way?
Does your child find it hard to stay with one activity for a few minutes?
Does your child turn to look at you when you call their name?

red_flags.text_en: Has your child stopped using words or skills that they used to have?
Does your child hurt themselves on purpose, for example by hitting their head or biting themselves?
Has your child had a fit (seizure), or episodes of jerking movements or not responding?
Does your child have trouble breathing, or turn blue around the lips?
Has your child stopped eating or drinking, or are they losing weight?
Are you worried about your child's safety right now, or that someone may be hurting them?

result_copy.no_strong_signs: Your answers do not show strong signs of a developmental concern right now. If you are still worried, talk to your child's doctor or therapist. This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.
result_copy.discuss_with_professional: Some of your answers suggest it would help to talk about your child's development with a professional. This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.
result_copy.see_professional_soon: Your answers suggest your child should see a developmental professional soon. This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.

urgent_copy: Please contact your child's doctor now. In an emergency call 108 (ambulance) or 112.
